title: Replace tautological isNotNull assertion on non-nullable testConfig field in learning_program_service_test.dart
rule: TQ-8 (tautological assertion — asserts what the type system already guarantees, not real behavior)
why: LearningProgramData.testConfig is declared as a non-nullable String, so expect(p.testConfig, isNotNull) can never fail — it's checking a compile-time guarantee, not runtime behavior. The test's evident intent (verify the '{}' fallback applied in learning_program_service.dart:86 when a seed omits test_config) is never actually asserted, so a regression that defaults testConfig to '' or breaks the fallback would pass this test silently.
recommendation: Replace with a behavioral assertion, e.g. expect(p.testConfig, isNotEmpty), or explicitly assert the '{}' default for seeds that omit test_config.
acceptance_criteria: Assertion changed to one that can fail (verified by temporarily breaking the source default and confirming red, then reverting to green)
